name: Arc UNSW Food Hub
summary: Free food pantry with staples, fresh produce and hygiene products at Kensington and Paddington.
key: A free food pantry with pantry staples, snacks, fruit and vegetables, and hygiene products.
who: UNSW students (first 45 minutes of each session are UNSW students only)
how: Register via Humanitix and attend a session at Kensington (near Gate 2) or Paddington
catches: Session times are changing; check the event pages before visiting
Paddington runs in term time only

evidence.quote: free food pantry and student support & sustainability program
